title: CAPEX advanced columns design (VAT / WHT / depreciation / payment schedule / utilisation)
purpose: Design each advanced CAPEX column in detail. None of the columns are wired to the backend in this PR. The wiring requires backend changes (IDC engine, funding drawdown, tax engine, depreciation schedule) that are explicitly out of scope for 57A-7.

columns.name: cost_per_mw
columns.phase_to_wire: already shown in top card strip; per-line is a UI PR

columns.name: vat
columns.backend_wiring_required: new vat_applicability and vat_rate_pct fields on CapexItem

columns.name: depreciation
columns.backend_wiring_required: new fields on CapexItem + depreciation schedule generator

columns.name: payment_schedule_m1_m18
columns.backend_wiring_required: new monthly_schedule: tuple[float, ...] field on CapexItem
feeds: Opening senior debt balance at COD

columns.name: utilisation
columns.backend_wiring_required: new utilisation: tuple[float, ...] field on CapexItem
feeds: Same as payment schedule (drawdown / IDC chain)

staged_backend_integration.rationale: No model effect; pure UI annotation; safest first column.
staged_backend_integration.backend_changes: new comments: str field on CapexItem

staged_backend_integration.rationale: Derived column; UI-only; no backend change.
All three affect cash flow / balance sheet / working capital / tax. Stage together.
staged_backend_integration.backend_changes: new capex.tax_engine module + new contingency_pct, vat_applicability, vat_rate_pct, wht_rate_pct fields on CapexItem

staged_backend_integration.rationale: Requires depreciation schedule generator; larger effort; own PR.
staged_backend_integration.backend_changes: new depreciation_category, useful_life_years, is_depreciable fields on CapexItem + depreciation schedule generator

staged_backend_integration.rationale: Together feed IDC and funding drawdown chain. Largest stage.
staged_backend_integration.backend_changes: new monthly_schedule: tuple[float, ...] and utilisation: tuple[float, ...] fields on CapexItem + construction funding engine changes
